frozen_manifest_unit.title: Nanodisc multimodal record versus derived conformational ensemble
frozen_manifest_unit.challenge_intent: Test whether an integrated ensemble is recorded as derived rather than treated as a native measurement.

source_first_pass_a.scientific_question: Does the pattern distinguish Bengtsen's individual NMR/SAXS/SANS observations from the conformational ensemble derived by integrating them with MD?

source_identity_and_locators.citation: Bengtsen et al. (2020), Structure and dynamics of a nanodisc by integrating NMR, SAXS and SANS experiments with molecular dynamics simulations, eLife.

exact_pdf_locators.scope: two nanodiscs, SAXS/SANS with MD and prior NMR/EPR, and a derived/validated conformational ensemble.
nanodisc system context and intended integrative setting.

source_objects.native_observable: NMR, SAXS, and SANS experiment-specific records, with MD simulations used in an integrative analysis.
source_objects.estimand: A conformational ensemble representing nanodisc structure and dynamics.
source_objects.statistical_unit: One of two named nanodiscs and its modality-specific experimental records.
source_objects.spatial_support: Nanodisc shape, lipid ordering, and ensemble-level structural features.
source_objects.temporal_or_ensemble_semantics: The result is a conformational-heterogeneity/ensemble description rather than a raw experimental trace.
source_objects.transformations_and_model_assumptions: The ensemble is derived by combining experimental data with MD; it is not identical to any one raw modality.
source_objects.uncertainty_or_reliability_boundaries: The abstract does not by itself specify every modality's individual processing or data lineage.

atomic_source_supported_statements.statement: The abstract says the study combines SAXS and SANS experiments with MD and previously obtained NMR/EPR data.
The abstract describes deriving and validating a conformational ensemble that represents nanodisc structure and dynamics.

source_first_pass_a.source_relationship: The source spans multiple measurements and a derived ensemble; this record does not assign a scientific truth value to the ensemble.
source_first_pass_a.maximum_source_supported_wording: The study supports distinguishing modality records from its integratively derived conformational ensemble.
forbidden_generalizations: Treat the derived ensemble as a raw SAXS, SANS, or NMR observable.
Treat source integration as automatic validation independence.
missing_information: Detailed per-modality data processing and source-lineage fields are not extracted from the bounded passages.
possible_reusable_review_obligations: Require separate raw-observable and derived-estimand fields.

F03R01 is appropriately applied to the SOURCE target with declared measurement semantics, while integration quality and validation independence remain outside its claim ceiling.
